topic.title: Anaerobic Digestion / Biogas / Digestate

scope_guards: A feedstock availability estimate is not treated as a secured supply contract.
A waste exemption registration is not treated as compliance outside its limits.
A permit application is not treated as a granted permit.
A granted permit is not treated as constructed process capacity.
Biogas design output is not treated as measured production.
A digestate specification is not treated as an accepted land-spreading route.
Commissioning is not treated as sustained compliant operation.
No score or promotion is written without exact permit, feedstock, construction, commissioning, monitoring and outlet evidence.
